document.title: Fix fixture serve printout, add mixed covering doc, and a thin UI smoke
document.summary: `pnpm fixture` prints a serve command that works from `fixtures/repo` and writes a mixed covering document. `pnpm fixture:smoke` hits `#overview` and one group, then stops the server.

sources.title: Fixtures: fix serve printout + mixed parts/lookFor covering doc
sources.gist: The printed serve command must work from fixtures/repo, and the fixture covering document must have parts and lookFor.

sources.title: Deterministic browser smoke for review UI (no video-review dependency)
sources.gist: One thin command should smoke the mixed fixture without a large browser harness.

sources.label: PR #89
sources.title: Fix fixture serve printout, add mixed covering doc, and a thin UI smoke
sources.gist: One pull request implements #85 and a thin #86.

sources.label: Fix fixture serve printout and add a mixed covering document
sources.gist: Print node ../../dist/cli/main.js and write parts, dependsOn, lookFor, and sources.

sources.label: Add a thin mixed-fixture UI smoke command
sources.gist: pnpm fixture:smoke serves the mixed fixture, hits hashes, asserts HTTP 200, then stops.

lookFor: [#85](source:s1) asks agents to open Overview with colored stories without a hand-written review.json. `pnpm fixture` writes the mixed covering document to `fixtures/example/review.json`.
[#86](source:s2) asks to skip a large browser harness. This change adds `pnpm fixture:smoke` with `fetch`, not Playwright.

parts.name: Mixed fixture
parts.summary: `pnpm fixture` prints relative serve paths and writes a mixed covering document with parts, lookFor, and sources.

parts.name: UI smoke
parts.summary: `pnpm fixture:smoke` serves that fixture on a managed port, asserts HTTP 200 and key text, then exits.

groups.title: Mixed covering document
groups.why: [#85](source:s1) needs a first-class mixed covering document so Overview columns can be checked.
groups.summary: `mixedCoveringDocument` assigns example-repo hunks to three parts with dependsOn, lookFor, and sources.
lookFor: For `pnpm fixture`, the written document has at least two `parts` entries, a document `lookFor`, and a group with `dependsOn`.

groups.title: Fixture serve printout
groups.why: [#85](source:s1) says the printed command 404s because cwd is `fixtures/repo` and the CLI path is `dist/cli/main.js`.
groups.summary: `fixtureCommands` prints `node ../../dist/cli/main.js` and data paths relative to the fixture cwd.
lookFor: From cwd `fixtures/repo`, the printed serve line uses `../../dist/cli/main.js` and `--data ../example/review.json`.

groups.title: Fixture tests
groups.why: The mixed document and relative printout need tests so a later example-repo change fails here.
groups.summary: Tests check relative printout paths and validate the mixed covering document against the example repo.

groups.title: README fixture sentence
groups.why: The fixture section still described a refs-only unlabeled review.
groups.summary: The README fixture paragraph names the mixed covering document.

groups.title: Fixture UI smoke
groups.why: [#86](source:s2) wants one documented command that smokes the mixed fixture without Playwright.
groups.summary: `scripts/fixture-smoke.ts` serves the mixed fixture on port 4579, fetches `#overview` and `#group/app`, then closes the server.
lookFor: After `pnpm fixture:smoke`, the process exits and nothing still listens on port 4579.

groups.title: Smoke command and Cloud note
groups.why: [#86](source:s2) asks to document the one command. [#85](source:s1) asks for a short Cursor Cloud fixture note.
groups.summary: `package.json` adds `fixture:smoke`. AGENTS.md records fixture → serve → URL and that smoke command.
